mapper.sql: select r.id, r.receive_no, r.work_order_id, w.work_no, w.service_fee, w.currency, r.receive_time, r.doc_status, r.customs_status, r.execute_type, r.last_uuid, r.remark, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time from br_receive r left join br_work_order w on w.id = r.work_order_id
mapper.select: select max(receive_no) from br_receive where receive_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into br_receive (receive_no, work_order_id, receive_time, doc_status, customs_status, execute_type, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiveNo}, #{workOrderId}, #{receiveTime}, '01', '00', '1', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update br_receive set update_time = sysdate(), last_uuid = #{uuid}, doc_status = #{docStatus}, customs_status = #{customsStatus}, execute_type = #{executeType} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update br_receive set del_flag = '2' where id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into br_receive_item (receive_id, material_id, material_num, return_type) values (#{receiveId}, #{materialId}, #{materialNum}, #{returnType})
